Kit summary

Dance TrippinglyBasic
Deals 160% ATK DMG to all enemies and steals 1 layer of buff from every enemy. When enemies launch basic attacks or cast skills proactively to Apsara, she casts Dance Trippingly to counterattack once. This effect can only triggered once each turn.
Fluttering DressActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Grants [Kinnara] on the ally with the highest initial ATK for 2 turns: When the owner is inflicted with a control effect, transfers this effect to Apsara. [Kinnara] can only be triggered 3 times within 1 of the ally's turns. Afterward, attacks all enemies, dealing 340% ATK DMG.
Gold-thread Shawl Lv.1Each time Apsara is immune to control effects, increases 10% Turn Meter for self and the ally with [Kinnara]. When Apsara has [Momentum], increases 30% Skill DMG for all allies. At the beginning of each wave, Apsara inflicts [Karmic Punishment] (reduces DMG dealt by 50%) on enemies with countered Mark for 4 turns. When an enemy with [Karmic Punishment] inflicted by the effect above tries inflicting [Stun], [Horrify], and [Suffocated] on Apsara, she will inflict [Karmic Punishment] on all enemies for 4 turns and additionally reduces Skill DMG by 50% for the targets with [Karmic Punishment]; this effect can only be triggered once.
Gold-thread Shawl Lv.2Apsara is able to gain Resonance Points when she is under [Resonance Enhancement] status. Apsara provides 30% Resonance DMG bonus for the ally with [Kinnara]. If Apsara has [Momentum] at the same time, increases the recordable value by 30% of the original.
Elegant DancingPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Max Limit of Resonance Points: 10. At the end of any ally's turn, grants Apsara 1 Resonance Point. When Resonance Points reach the max limit, Apsara resets the CD of Fluttering Dress and Lotus Dance, acts for 1 extra turn, and then enters [Resonance Enhancement] status for 4 turns. Each time after Apsara enters [Resonance Enhancement] status, she will choose one of the following effects: 1. Replaces Fluttering Dress with Fluttering Dress · Resonance for 4 turns before Aspara casts Fluttering Dress proactively next time. 2. Replaces Lotus Dance with Lotus Dance · Resonance for 4 turns before Aspara casts Lotus Dance proactively next time. When Apsara is under [Resonance Enhancement] status, she is immune to control effects and cannot gain Resonance Points.

At the beginning of each wave, Apsara inflicts [Karmic Punishment] (reduces DMG dealt by 50%) on enemies with countered Mark for 4 turns. Gold-thread Shawl Lv.3When a wave starts, increases 30% Turn Meter and enters [Resonance Enhancement] status for 4 turns if Apsara has the highest SPD among all allies. After any enemy acts, Apsara steals 20% Turn Meter from the enemy with the most Turn Meter among all other enemies (this effect can only be triggered once in 1 of Apsara's turns.
